notes: Vignette form (no Breakdown) delivering scene spec: delight / genre(scam). Primary soak target frame:giveme-noun (குடுங்க, hinted→cold per trip deck) lands 6 times across distinct noun slots: தட்டு (pass the plate), அது (give me that), டீ (one tea), and three abstract slot uses (the explanation and closing lines). The reveal arc: Host A notices Host B has cleared the tea spread using only குடுங்க — hand-to-hand, no announcement — and calls it a scam; Host B explains the system (வேணும் opens questions; குடுங்க bypasses them); the twist is Host B even used குடுங்க for a sweet she doesn't like, then passed it to Elder Sister; Host A is converted and plans to deploy the system at tomorrow's tea. Callbacks: பிடிக்காது (the disliked sweet) and சீக்கிரம் (describing the speed of the hand-to-hand move) both land naturally. New words: சாயங்காலம் (evening, twice — scene-opener and closing plan line), தட்டு (plate, the first kudunga prop), தெரியல (compressed 'don't know', Host B's reaction to being caught), டீ (tea, ultra-answerable at a tea table). Unfenced: 'எல்லாமே' (everything, 1 occurrence) — universally obvious from context, used in prior episodes without marking. Diverges cleanly from M62 grief/nostalgia/lore, M61 revelation/classic, M60 nostalgia/classic: first vignette and first delight and first genre-ingredient episode in the recent run.
